notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

rules.text: The 4th lord and the ascendant lord together in the 4th with a benefic aspect: the full happiness of home.
The 4th lord in its own or exalted sign: the comforts of land, vehicles, a house and music.
The 10th lord together with the 4th lord in an angle or trine: a well-built, well-finished home.
A benefic 4th lord aspected by a benefic, with Mercury in the ascendant: loved and respected by relatives.
The 4th lord and Venus in angles with Mercury exalted: full happiness from the mother.
The Sun in the 4th, Saturn and the Moon in the 9th and Mars in the 11th: wealth in livestock and land.

variants.text: The 4th and 11th lords exchange houses: vehicles come early in life (the text says the 12th year).
The Sun in the 4th with an exalted 4th lord joined by Venus: a vehicle around the 32nd year.
The 4th house is under benefic influence only: matters of home and vehicles go well.
The 4th house is under malefic influence only: matters of home and vehicles meet difficulties.
